quests.title: Pocket monster
quests.description: Doodle a tiny creature that lives in your pocket. Give it a name and one weird habit.

twists.text: Draw it with your eyes closed.
Only circles and triangles allowed.
Use your other hand.

quests.title: Six-word saga
quests.description: Write a whole adventure story in exactly six words.

twists.text: The story must involve a sandwich.
Make it spooky.
Every word starts with the same letter.

quests.title: Promote an object
quests.description: Pick something on your desk. Give it a superhero name, a power and a weakness.

twists.text: Its weakness has to be totally normal, like Mondays.
Give it a dramatic catchphrase too.

quests.title: Three-panel comic
quests.description: Draw a 3-panel comic about what your chair does when nobody is watching.

twists.text: No words allowed.
Panel three needs a plot twist.

quests.title: Fancy paint names
quests.description: Pick 3 colors you can see right now and name them like expensive paint colors.

twists.text: Every name must be food-themed.
Name them like magic spells.

quests.title: One-line portrait
quests.description: Draw a face without lifting your pen off the paper even once.

twists.text: Make it a self-portrait.
A magnificent mustache is mandatory.

quests.title: Invent a holiday
quests.description: Make up a brand-new holiday. What is it called, and how do people celebrate?

twists.text: It celebrates a vegetable.
It has a mascot. Describe it.

quests.title: Treasure map
quests.description: Draw a treasure map of the room you are in. Mark where the treasure is buried.

twists.text: Add a dragon guarding something boring.
Hide a real tiny object where the X is.

quests.title: Lunch remix
quests.description: Retitle your favorite song so it is about your last meal.

twists.text: Hum the first line with the new title.

quests.title: Square breathing
quests.description: Breathe in for 4, hold for 4, out for 4, hold for 4. Four rounds.

twists.text: Trace a square in the air with your finger as you go.

quests.title: 5-4-3-2-1 scan
quests.description: Notice 5 things you see, 4 you can touch, 3 you hear, 2 you smell and 1 you taste.

quests.title: Shoulder melt
quests.description: Lift your shoulders up to your ears, hold for 3 seconds, then let them drop. Five times.

quests.title: Potion of hydration
quests.description: Get a glass of water and sip it slowly, like it is a rare and fancy potion.

twists.text: Review it out loud like a fancy food critic.

quests.title: Eye vacation
quests.description: Look at something far away for 20 seconds. Your eyes have been staring at screens all day.

quests.title: Slow-mo mode
quests.description: Do your next small action, like picking up a cup, in super slow motion.

twists.text: Add slow-motion sound effects.

quests.title: Tiny tidy
quests.description: Put exactly three things back where they belong. Only three. Then stop, proudly.

quests.title: Starfish stretch
quests.description: Stand up and stretch as wide as a starfish for 10 seconds.

twists.text: Add the biggest yawn you can manage.

quests.title: Glad it exists
quests.description: Think of one oddly specific thing you are glad exists today. Socks without holes count.

quests.title: Real compliment
quests.description: Compliment someone on something they chose, like their playlist or their idea.

quests.title: Send a smile
quests.description: Send a friend something that will make them smile. No reason needed.

twists.text: Use emojis only.
Send a tiny drawing instead.

quests.title: The ant question
quests.description: Ask someone: if you could shrink to ant size for a day, what would you do?

twists.text: Ask about being a giant instead.
Ask both, then compare answers.

quests.title: High-five hunt
quests.description: Get a high-five from someone. Virtual high-fives totally count.

quests.title: Share a gem
quests.description: Recommend a song, show or game you love to someone, and say why in one sentence.

quests.title: Tiny thank-you
quests.description: Thank someone for something small they did recently. Small is the point.

twists.text: Leave it as a note for them to find.

quests.title: Two truths, one lie
quests.description: Play one round of two truths and a lie with someone.

quests.title: Old friend ping
quests.description: Say hi to someone you have not talked to in a while.

quests.title: Cloud detective
quests.description: Find a cloud, stain or pattern that looks like an animal.

quests.title: Sound safari
quests.description: Close your eyes for 30 seconds and count how many different sounds you hear.

quests.title: Alphabet hunt
quests.description: Find something nearby for every letter from A to F.

twists.text: Keep going all the way to J.
Start from F and go backwards.

quests.title: Texture hunt
quests.description: Find the softest, bumpiest and smoothest things within arm's reach.

quests.title: New angle
quests.description: Look at your room from a spot where you never stand or sit. What looks different?

twists.text: Lie on the floor and look up.

quests.title: Macro world
quests.description: Take a super close-up photo of something ordinary until it looks like an alien planet.

quests.title: Color quest
quests.description: Pick a color, then spot 5 things in that color around you.

twists.text: Use the color of the last thing you ate.
Find 10 instead of 5.

quests.title: Window story
quests.description: Look outside and invent a backstory for the first person, animal or car you see.

quests.title: Time traveler
quests.description: Find the oldest object near you. Guess how old it is and where it has been.

quests.title: Trash can three-pointer
quests.description: Crumple a scrap of paper and land it in a bin from three big steps away.

twists.text: Shoot with your other hand.
Bounce it off a wall first.

quests.title: Stack attack
quests.description: Stack 5 random objects into the tallest tower you can.

twists.text: Include at least two round things.

quests.title: Staring contest
quests.description: Have a staring contest with a mirror, a pet or a friend.

quests.title: Desk drummer
quests.description: Drum a beat on your desk for 20 seconds, then try to repeat it exactly.

quests.title: Best of five
quests.description: Play rock-paper-scissors best of five. No opponent? Left hand versus right hand.

quests.title: Flamingo mode
quests.description: Stand on one foot for 30 seconds. Then try it with your eyes closed.

quests.title: Word chain
quests.description: Say a word, then a word starting with its last letter. How long can you go?

twists.text: Animals only.
Food only.

quests.title: Pen flip
quests.description: Flip a pen so it lands standing up. You get ten tries.

quests.title: Name that hum
quests.description: Hum a song and see if someone can guess it. Solo? Hum it and guess the next line.

quests.title: Nature documentary
quests.description: Narrate what you are doing for 30 seconds like a whispering wildlife documentary host.

quests.title: Secret handshake
quests.description: Invent a secret handshake with at least four moves. Teach it to someone, or your cat.

quests.title: Confident nonsense
quests.description: Make up a fake fact about a nearby object and say it with total confidence.

quests.title: Villain laugh
quests.description: Practice your best evil-villain laugh. Three attempts. Commit fully.

quests.title: Thank an object
quests.description: Thank something you use every day, out loud. It has been working hard.

quests.title: Runway walk
quests.description: Walk to the next room like it is a fashion runway.

twists.text: Do it as a robot.
Do it as a penguin.

quests.title: Ten-second dance party
quests.description: Dance like nobody is watching for ten seconds. Chair dancing counts.

twists.text: Only your eyebrows are allowed to dance.

quests.title: Ghost roommate
quests.description: A friendly ghost lives in your room. What is its name, and what does it complain about?

quests.title: Backwards name
quests.description: Say your full name backwards. Then try someone else's.

quests.title: Note to future you
quests.description: Write a one-sentence note to yourself a year from now and hide it somewhere sneaky.
